Please note.. minimum of 10 dogs staying on the hotel for them to assign an attendant looking-out for your dogs overnight. First hand experience, we wanted to pick up our dog around 9:00pm. But there was no one, contacts unreachable. We could hear the dogs barking, I felt they were getting old. No choice, we went back the following morning around 7:30am, there was still no one. So I waited for the staff to arrive, around 8:30am (since their opening time is 9:00am). I asked the staff if they assigned somebody to watch over the dogs during night time. She confirmed that there was a minimum of 10 dogs before they assigned an attendant. Since there were only 4 dogs in the hotel at that time, no one was looking after them at night. Therefore, I was wrong to assume that Pet Hotel is 24/7 with someone attending to the dogs. In case of emergencies, like Earthquake, Fire or something else. There is no safety for the dog. Madat.ogan already there, already toasted in the distance. There is no attendant. In Grooming services, Spa.. I salute them.. clean, smooth work. Only at the hotel. But that's the rules/policy. In short, for those who want a Pet Hotel. Just heads up, ing.ani ilahang system. Hopefully they'll make some positive action regarding this matter.
